title: Colab batch colab-p01: provenance and run record
summary: Standardized publication record of the first Colab stress batch (100 of 1,000 periodic TOIs, pinned commit 2b65d44): 1,107 ledger runs as a sanitized CSV, the 387 checksum-verified MAST products as the site's standard manifest view, and the batch summary. The companion ledger is never merged; run ids are companion-ledger ids.
description_md: The batch ran on a Colab CPU High-RAM runtime (8 vCPU / 51 GB, `--jobs 7`) against the pinned public commit, 100/100 campaigns finished, 0 failed. The checkpoint on Drive (3,330 objects, 982.2 MiB) was verified intact: 3,327/3,327 manifest hashes match and all 387 product SHA-256s inside the records match. Products are **linked, never re-hosted**; the CSV exports only the site's public-run allowlisted fields, so local paths and per-run extras never leave the project.
research_status: Engineering record · provenance only · no science claims
